name: the-high-council
description: The High Council MCP server (multi-model planning harness, BYOK) plus the generic skills in skills/, packaged as one Claude Code plugin.

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic API key
anthropic_api_key.description: Optional. Your own Anthropic key, used only for the chains that seat a Anthropic model. Leave it empty to use ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from your environment or .env instead.
